gates.requirement: No material errors, exact cash accounting, point-in-time timestamping.
gates.observed_result: Strict point-in-time timestamps verified across all 8 hypotheses; zero backward mapping.

gates.requirement: No unresolved lookahead, scaler peeking, or target leakage.
gates.observed_result: Expanding walk-forward partitions with isolated targets and strict temporal barriers.
gates.evidence_notes: Verified zero feature leakage across all modules.

gates.requirement: Chronological out-of-sample validation without test boundary manipulation.
gates.observed_result: Expanding window walk-forward validation applied; frozen hypothesis criteria preserved.
gates.evidence_notes: Hypothesis criteria pre-registered and frozen prior to evaluation.

gates.requirement: Positive economically meaningful gross edge (> 10 bps/trade).
gates.observed_result: Best net candidate P98-H007 produces 0.0 bps/trade gross expectancy, but fails net after costs.
gates.evidence_notes: Turnover friction and spread drag exceed gross alpha in all tradable setups.

gates.requirement: Positive net expectancy after realistic statutory Indian friction and slippage.
gates.observed_result: No tradable candidate produces positive net return and Sharpe > 0.50 after realistic costs.
gates.evidence_notes: Net returns remain negative or zero across ORB, Gap, 30m Momentum, and Volatility Breakout.

gates.observed_result: Strategies fail at 1.0x baseline friction; losses amplify linearly under 1.5x and 2.0x stress.
gates.evidence_notes: Double-entry cost engine verified friction decay across all intraday models.

gates.requirement: Consistent non-sideways performance without regime cherry-picking.
gates.observed_result: Strategy performance degrades or remains negative across multiple market conditions.
gates.evidence_notes: Regime conditioning (P98-H007) yields marginal Brier calibration gain (< 5.0%), not tradable alpha.

gates.requirement: Project-specific preregistered minimum sample size for confirmatory inference (N >= 60 trades).
gates.observed_result: P98-H001 sample contains 59 trades and does not satisfy project preregistered minimum criterion N>=60 for confirmatory classification; event study sample is limited to 13 events.

gates.requirement: Deterministic reproduction from code, documented datasets, and fixed seeds.
gates.observed_result: 100% reproducible with fixed random seed 42 and deterministic feature engineering.
gates.evidence_notes: All checksums and data parquets verified reproducible.

gates.requirement: Genuine executable market quotes with timestamped Bid/Ask depth.
gates.observed_result: Options quote observations show 102 paired quotes (0.68%), but continuous executable surface coverage is 0.0%. Executable backtesting is strictly BLOCKED.
gates.evidence_notes: Options quote audit reaffirmed 0.0% continuous executable surface coverage (102 paired quotes, 0.68%). Cross-sectional data carries survivorship bias.

decision_rationale: Phase 10 forward paper trading is NOT JUSTIFIED. Failed 5 gates and blocked on 1 gate (Data Quality / Executable Options Quotes). Intraday research identified valuable microstructure dynamics (ORB, gap reversal, compression), but the currently available sample (~59 sessions) is insufficient for confirmatory deployment, and all candidates fail to generate cost-robust positive net alpha. System safely concludes in RESEARCH_ONLY mode.
